lessonDecisions.note: The lesson applies when a hook or guard maps writes to a project record or root in a repository with more than one record. This task changes no guard or hook and no root discovery; every edit was inside g2's own files and none was denied for a wrong root. The one hook denial I met came from a Bash command whose text named a scratchpad path, which is the ownership rule working, not a wrong nested root.
